dismissals.because: .factory/stories/CWF-7/tasks/T7.json:2 This is Forge's own task-state file, written by forge task start on every task branch; main already carries the same file for every merged CWF-7 part (T1A to T4C). Removing it would break Forge's tracking of this part.

findings.body: This branch adds `.factory/stories/CWF-7/tasks/T7.json`, which only records branch status and a start timestamp. The part is limited to `docs/architecture/deployment.md`, and this metadata is unnecessary for the production check. Remove it from the change.
findings.title: Remove the out-of-scope task metadata file
